body:
This past Sunday I ingested 300 Heavenly Blue Morning Glory seeds. I ground them up in a coffee grinder. I mixed them into apple sauce and washed it down with Orange juice. I took an anti nausea pill prior to that. So I had no nausea at all.
After about a couple of hours I was Saint Francis of Assisi or Saint Ignatius of Loyola. I was blessing the family pictures on my fireplace mantle. They weren't mere pictures anymore. The spirits and souls of my entire generational family were alive and very much present. Soon after that I experienced the crucifixion and resurrection of Christ Himself! It's as if God had poured His spirit into my body. I had total Bliss, inner knowing, illumination, total pure awareness and complete enlightenment. I knew all! There is no such thing as death. We are One with God.
It was truly an experience of all experiences! No outer eye or inner eye visions. Just being One with The Godhead. What a refreshing experience!
God Bless and Love!
